name: MANDA
description: MANDA is a Japanese M&A marketplace search engine that aggregates business-for-sale listings (small and mid-size companies seeking acquisition or business succession) from across Japan. This connector lets AI agents search public, anonymized sell-side listings by keyword, region, revenue range, and asking price, retrieve full listing details, and browse industry and region master data. All tools are read-only and free to use; no account is required. Contacting sellers requires free registration on manda.bz. Listings and tool responses are in Japanese.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MANDA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MANDA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://manda.bz/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MANDA MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MANDA provides these MCP tools: search_deals, get_deal, list_areas, and list_industries.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MANDA?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MANDA in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
MANDA does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
MANDA is developed by MANDA Inc. (MANDA株式会社). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
